evidence.notes: No dependencies were downgraded, overridden, or vendored; dev dependencies remain audited. The person explicitly expanded scope to repair the unrelated agentMail concurrency timeout blocking c2. Root cause was a 4-second CPU busy-spin consuming 27% of the test timeout; the deterministic parent-controlled readiness barrier preserves simultaneous cross-process SQLite contention and awaits all child exits. No timeout, retry, skip, or weakened assertion was introduced.

outputs.summary: Added a graph-aware npm audit policy that allows only GHSA-fc5q-39xc-vjpf and its exclusive transitive chain while continuing to block every unrelated moderate-or-higher advisory. PR CI now runs the policy checker. Documented dev-only exposure and the exact removal condition. Replaced the mail concurrency test's CPU-burning timed spin with a deterministic child readiness barrier so the required full gate is stable without retries or timeout increases.
